_doc: OGRL-20261007-011 (switched off). Forks run38. ONE change: --d-min 0.7, so every fight is drawn at difficulty U(0.7, 1.0). Measured on run38 since 55M (50,148 episodes): difficulty ~ U(0, 1) put only 7.8% of training fights in the benchmark's own cell (1v3, d >= 0.8, win rate 0.37); ~60% of fights were ones it already wins 70-96% of the time. Question: does concentrating on hard fights raise canonical 1v3 above run38's 0.31-0.36 plateau (55M-75M) within ~30M steps? Risk: fewer easy wins means sparser win signal; the learnability opponent mix still keeps 1v1/1v2 in.
purpose: OGRL-20261007-011 run42: run38 fork, difficulty floor 0.7 (train where the benchmark is)
